waterPlannerSubtitle: Precision FAO-56 crop evapotranspiration (ETc), volumetric water demand, and pump run-time scheduling.
quickPresetsDesc: Test drip, sprinkler, flood, and rain-fed conditions
kcDesc: Standard FAO-56 coefficient representing crop transpiration ratio relative to grass reference.
et0Desc: Atmospheric water evaporation rate measured in millimetres per day.
rainfallCreditDesc: Precipitation received in the past 24–48 hours that directly reduces irrigation depth needed.
efficiencyDesc: Accounts for deep percolation, evaporation, and distribution uniformity losses.
pumpRateDesc: Tube-well or submersible pump discharge rate. Typical 3 HP pump discharges ~3,000 L/h.
sufficientRainTitle: Recent Rainfall Covers Crop Water Demand
sufficientRainDesc: Recent precipitation meets or exceeds the crop evapotranspiration demand. Pumping is not needed today, conserving fuel and electricity.
rainfedNoticeDesc: This field relies on natural precipitation. Pump run time is 0 hours as no mechanical pump is utilized.
stepByStepSubtitle: Transparent FAO-56 scientific breakdown of each calculation stage
unitConsistencyNote: Unit Consistency Note: 1 mm of water depth applied uniformly across 1 square metre (m²) equals exactly 1 Litre of water volume.
timingTip: Application Timing: Irrigate early in the morning (6:00 AM – 8:30 AM) or after sunset to minimize atmospheric evaporation loss and solar wind drift.
floweringTip: Flowering Stage Sensitivity: Flowering is a critical moisture-stress threshold. Avoid extended deficit to prevent blossom abortion and poor fruit set.
uniformityTip: System Uniformity: For drip lines, inspect drippers regularly for calcium scaling or algae clogging; flush sub-mains weekly at 1.5 bar operating pressure.
validationErrorsDesc: Please correct the highlighted fields below to view accurate estimates:
awaitingValidInputsDesc: Fill in all required fields above or click any of the Quick Test Presets to view real-time volumetric calculations.
etcFormulaExplanation: ETc (Crop Need) = ET0 (Weather Evapotranspiration) × Kc (Crop Coefficient)
volumeFormulaExplanation: Litres = Net Depth (mm) × Area (m²) ÷ Irrigation System Efficiency
